comparison.objective: Measure a sprung-leg training doll on an infantometer.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold both spring-loaded legs straight while sliding a footboard to both soles, then withdraw.
comparison.success_condition: Valid crown/sole contact held, reading preserved within 5 mm, doll kept on board, and both grippers clear.
comparison.reason: Tests compliant multi-joint restraint and measurement, not material separation or fragment containment.
